cause: Avatar activation used the image-area anchor, which could be below the viewport. The marker became active but Radix hideWhenDetached hid the conversation.
behavior: Avatar-opened conversations follow their marker, including grouped choices. Area-opened conversations still follow their highlighted area. Opening keeps the page still and focuses the reply.

checks.regression_before: The new tall-image avatar case failed because no visible Comment thread was found. Live reproduction confirmed aria-pressed=true on the marker and visibility=hidden on the dialog.
checks.extended_coverage: Single and grouped image avatars; image-area and whole-image threads; desktop and 390px width; reply focus; unchanged scroll on opening; Escape restoration; direct area activation.
checks.browser_fallback: Two T3 preview snapshots failed with Preview automation snapshot timed out after 15000ms; live verification used Chrome.
